notes.title: Patch 1.0.3
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45045165/2d3657897a49c3f8744f2cfb62ac872a4524bb47.png[/img]

[h1]Corruption Rework[/h1]
Many players felt too punished for failing to meet the [b]Restoration[/b] criteria within 10 days. Previously, with enemies permanently buffed, it became extremely difficult to recover. To address this, I’ve made a [b]significant[/b] change to the mechanic.

Now, [b]only the boss's health[/b] is affected by Corruption. This means you’ll only need to focus your defenses during boss invasions rather than dealing with a continuous increase in enemy strength.

However, [b]Restoration is still crucial[/b]—if ignored, bosses will become extremely difficult to stop and will deal massive damage to your [b]Stronghold[/b].

[h1]Balancing Changes[/h1]
Other than the changes for the corruption system, I have tried to make slight adjustments that will hopefully favor the player and make things a bit more balanced.

[h2]General[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Removed all crossroads and loops[/b] for the path in the starting area.
[/list]

[h2]Defense Buildings[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Shooting Bunker[/b] Attack Rate [b]buffed[/b]: [b]0.7 → 1[/b]
[*][b]Ballista[/b] Attack Damage [b]nerfed[/b]: [b]50 → 25[/b]
[*][b]Ballista[/b] New Skill [b]added[/b]: [b]Critical Hit 30%[/b]
[*][b]Axe Tower[/b] Lethality [b]buffed[/b]: [b]4 → 5[/b]
[*][b]Catapult[/b] Explosive Damage [b]buffed[/b]: [b]70 → 85[/b]
[/list]

[h2]Utility Buildings[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Church[/b] Rarity [b]changed[/b]: [b]Blue Tier → Green Tier[/b]
[*][b]Church[/b] Restoration Income [b]nerfed[/b]: [b]4 → 3[/b]
[*][b]Pyramid[/b] Rarity [b]changed[/b]: [b]Gold Tier → Blue Tier[/b]
[*][b]Pyramid[/b] Restoration Income [b]nerfed[/b]: [b]3 base + 2 per Church → 2 base + 1 per Church[/b]
[*][b]Library[/b] Research Income [b]buffed[/b]: [b]3 → 4[/b]
[/list]

[h2]Enemies[/h2]

[h3]Enemy Nerfs[/h3]
[list]
[*][b]Yellow Slime[/b] Move Speed: [b]1.28 → 1.2[/b]
[*][b]Yellow Slime[/b] HP: [b]640 → 620[/b]
[*][b]Orc[/b] HP: [b]1300 → 1200[/b]
[*][b]Red Knight[/b] HP: [b]1700 → 1600[/b]
[*][b]Gold Knight[/b] HP: [b]2300 → 2200[/b]
[*][b]Big Bug[/b] HP: [b]4800 → 4400[/b]
[*][b]Slime Boss[/b] HP: [b]3200 → 2800[/b]
[*][b]Troll Boss[/b] HP: [b]8000 → 6500[/b]
[*][b]Knight Boss[/b] HP: [b]5500 → 5000[/b]
[*][b]Bug Boss[/b] HP: [b]13,000 → 11,000[/b]
[/list]

[h3]Enemy Buffs[/h3]
[list]
[*][b]Slime Boss[/b] Speed: [b]0.8 → 1[/b]
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.0.2
notes.content:
[h2]Music Rework[/h2]
Now after the game has been out for a little while, my wonderful musician [b]Jan-Peter Itze[/b] felt like the music could be improved. We brainstormed together and managed to make something that we are both very proud of. Hope you enjoy the changes that he made.

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Restoration accords that give restoration on specific resource acquired, now actually gives restoration from all sources and not just filling the related resource bar.
[*] Fixed issue where Restoration accords related to depleting a specific resource node gave restoration from the unrelated resource nodes as well.
[*] Tooltip for the [b]Ramp up[/b] skill has been clarified to say [b]Attack Rate[/b] instead of [b]Dexterity[/b]
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1
notes.content:
Thank you for being patient waiting for updates on the reported bugs. Thank you for enjoying the game and I hope the wait has been worth it!

[h2]Balancing Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Axe Tower[/b] base damage nerfed from 40 → 25
[*] Added [b]Lethality[/b] skill to [b]Axe Tower[/b]
[*] [b]Archer Tower[/b] base attack rate nerfed from 0.85 → 0.8
[*] Nerfed [b]Morality[/b] skill upgrades from 4/5 → 3/4
[/list]

[h2]Bug fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed the bug where the game occasionally crashed or froze when you got defeated
[*] Fixed the bug where the you got stuck in the tutorial and not being able to close the window
[*] Fixed the bug where skill value text for expertise skills ended up on two rows
[/list]
